title: Xam'd: Lost Memories
synopsis: Sentan Island is a small island surrounded by the Yuden Sea. It exists in a state of dreamlike tranquility, cut off from the war between the Northern Government and the Southern Continent Free Zone. Our hero, Akiyuki Takehara, lives on Sentan Island along with his mother Fusa. He is currently separated from his father, the town doctor Ryuzo, but the bond between father and son remains. One day, after taking Ryuzo the lunch that Fusa has made for him as usual, Akiyuki arrives at school, where he is caught up in an explosion along with his friends, Haru and Furuichi. The explosion produces a mysterious light, which enters Akiyuki's arm, causing him excruciating pain. He's given no time to understand it, however, as the white-haired girl who rode on the bus with him guides him to a power unlike anything he's ever known.

episodes.title: Xam'd at the Dawn of War
episodes.synopsis: When a peaceful island is dragged into a violent war, a young boy transforms into a powerful mecha/human hybrid known as Xam’d.

episodes.title: Blackout On Sentan Island
episodes.synopsis: Akiyuki is taken aboard the air ship Zanbani to control the dangerous power of the mysterious mecha within him.

episodes.title: The Way to Freedom
episodes.synopsis: Though Nakiami tries to help Akiyuki control the Xam’d within him, the deadly humanforms are still drawn to its power.

episodes.title: Enlightenment
episodes.synopsis: A mysterious seer helps Akiyuki discover clues about the purpose of the Xam’d. Meanwhile, the Free Zone military builds an anti-humanform base.

episodes.title: Shattered Bonds
episodes.synopsis: Nakiami has a secret meeting with the black market pirate Zeygend. And the military begin using innocent Islanders in their humanform experiments.

episodes.title: Live Fire
episodes.synopsis: Akiyuki’s friends join the Free Zone military. And Nakiami disobeys Captain Ishu in order to save a humanform from turning into stone.

episodes.title: Guardians of Stone
episodes.synopsis: When the Free Zone military attacks a humanform, they discover a shocking secret about the creature they mean to destroy. Akiyuki begins a dangerous mission.

episodes.title: Showdown at Tsumebara Pass
episodes.synopsis: When the tracking device fails, Nakiami sets out to find Akiyuki. Also, Haru and Furuichi’s mission to find an ASP suit is only a cover for a much darker purpose for General Kakisu.

episodes.title: The Astonishing Raigyo
episodes.synopsis: The crew of the Zanbani celebrates the return of Raigyo. Dr. Kanba begins to use the green soulstone to perfect the anti-humanform weapons.

episodes.title: Moving On
episodes.synopsis: The truth about Raigyo’s connection with the Xam’d is revealed. And Akiyuki finds a reluctant mentor.

episodes.title: Assault: the Zanbani
episodes.synopsis: The Zanbani is attacked by a squadron of humanforms. The mysterious leader of the humanforms demand to have the Xam’d turned over to them.

episodes.title: Flowers Blooming in the Dark
episodes.synopsis: After the Zanbani crashes, the crew begins making repairs. But Nakiami and Akiyuki decide to strike out on their own.

episodes.title: Running Barefoot
episodes.synopsis: When Nakiami and Akiyuki return to Sentan Island, they find Furuichi has experienced a dangerous transformation.

episodes.title: Cerulean Skies
episodes.synopsis: Furuichi’s jealousy of Akiyuki begins to exert a dark and dangerous power over the Xam’d within him.

episodes.title: Souls at Peace
episodes.synopsis: Akiyuki is captured by slave traders while Nakiami befriends a young boy who is also possessed by Xam’d.

episodes.title: Burning in Our Wake
episodes.synopsis: Sukakki enlists Midori in a dangerous military experiment, while Akiyuki is purchased by a mysterious stranger.

episodes.title: Lambs to the Altar
episodes.synopsis: Akiyuki seems to recover under the care of a kindly but mysterious woman. Kakisu pressures Kanba to accelerate his dangerous experiments.

episodes.title: What Can You See from There?
episodes.synopsis: When Nakiami returns to Tessik, their leader Kujireika tries to persuade her to join their tribe.

episodes.title: Sudden Outbreak: Romance Flowers Bloom
episodes.synopsis: A captured enemy brings Professor Kanba to his knees and pushes General Kakisu to a dangerous rage.

episodes.title: Watered With Tears
episodes.synopsis: The Far East Autonomy begins their deadly air strike forcing Kujireika to retaliate.

episodes.title: Sanctuary Breached
episodes.synopsis: Lord Azami reveals he knows the real reason for General Kakisu’s bloodlust. Shiroza takes Akiyuki deep inside enemy lines.

episodes.title: Tojiro and Ryuzo
episodes.synopsis: When Shiroza finds he cannot convince Akiyuki and Haru to join his cause, he takes drastic measures against them.

episodes.title: Hiruken Emperor Born
episodes.synopsis: The Hiruken Emperor reveals himself at last, and the crew of the Zanbani suffers a devastating casualty.

episodes.title: Voices from Beyond
episodes.synopsis: Now overtaken by grief and her new powers as a test type Xam’d, Midori wreaks havoc on the warfront.

episodes.title: Nakiami and Sannova
episodes.synopsis: Akiyuki brings the fullness of his Xam’d powers to stop the Hiruken Emperor’s attack.

episodes.title: The Great Rock and the Girl
episodes.synopsis: Akiyuki strikes a bargain with the Hiruken Emperor in order to save the world.
